g.text: The cohort is not a random sample of cancer patients
One clinical fact may count as several features
Events, not patients, limit a survival model
Closer follow-up, not the tumour, may predict outcome
Check: none possible from within the cohort
Check: rank correlation among stage, pT, pN and others
Check: below 50 events, a result carries a warning
Check: early follow-up contacts against later events
